programme.title: The Quest for the Ark of the Covenant
programme.desc: In Judaism, it’s the most sacred object. A chest carved in acacia wood, gilded with gold leaf, and topped by two cherubs. The Ark of the Covenant strikes down the Mortal who touches it.

programme.title: The Quest for the Grail
programme.desc: It’s the most desired and sacred relic in Christianity. However, this artefact is shrouded in mystery. No one can say what it looks like. Today, dozens of churches claim to hold the Grail.

programme.title: The Power of King Solomon

programme.title: The Mystery of Fátima
programme.desc: The Shrine of Fatima in Portugal is one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world. More than 6 million visitors come every year to take a moment in this place.

programme.title: Camp Century
programme.desc: In 1959 the USA decided to build a military town under the ice sheet of North Greenland. The superpower wanted to use all its might to gain a strategic advantage over the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Life behind the Walls of Europe's Castles
programme.desc: What was life like behind a castle walls? The documentary follows their development from simple wooden fortifications to the most elaborate strongholds and residences.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gate
programme.desc: Castles were bastions of power. Yet, what if the enemy was at the gates? Our documentary examines the military function of castles from the 11th to the 16th century.

programme.title: Tinderbox Yugoslavia
programme.desc: Under the influence of changing rulers and empires, the country’s structure is formed over centuries as home to five nationalities with three languages and four different religions.

programme.title: A State Falls Apart
programme.desc: We are in the fateful year of Yugoslavia’s first free elections since World War II: 1990. It is the hour of the nationalists.

programme.title: Yugoslavia in Ruins
programme.desc: The Srebrenica massacre is a wake-up call for the international community, which decides to intervene after four years of war. That same year, the warring parties sign a peace treaty.

programme.title: The Balkans in Flames
programme.desc: The documentary THE BALKANS IN FLAMES examines the disintegration of the former Socialist Federation of Yugoslavia.

programme.title: The Rise of Judea
programme.desc: The Rise of Judea explores the tumultuous reign of King Herod and the ascent of Roman stewardship in Judea through the words of Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: The Fall of Judea
programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: Birth of a Brotherhood
programme.desc: At the beginning of the 12th century, a few knights decide to create a new brotherhood called "The order of the Temple".

programme.title: A business empire

programme.title: The East

programme.title: The West
programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The D-Days Spies
programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.

programme.title: The Soldier who never was

programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World
programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies
programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.

programme.title: The Maya
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.desc: Torrential late summer rains spell doom for Hugh's hay harvest, and only radical plant-surgery can save his tomatoes from blight, however the weather has helped mushrooms flourish. Hugh also enters a sheep in the Melpash Agricultural Show.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh embarks to sell his entire tomato harvest at the Farmer's Market by offering a diverse range of products under the brand name: The River Cottage Glutton. Hugh also makes a bet with a rival grower as to who will sell more at market.

programme.title: Return to River Cottage
programme.desc: With a failed hay harvest, Hugh conceives a cunning plan to supplement the winter feed he will need for his animals by throwing a party, but instead of a bottle he asks his guests to bring a bale. Hugh also agrees to an unusual request.

programme.title: Takeaway Titans
programme.desc: The top 6 beef and chicken takeaways in Ireland show off their grill skills to impress Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Rory O'Connor, to ultimately compete in the season's final cook off challenge.

programme.title: Secrets of the Caribbean

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh's new farm is 10 times the size of River Cottage, so he plans to expand production, including setting up a culinary headquarters where he can sell direct to the public, but he soon wonders if he has bitten off more than he can chew.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Several weeks after Hugh leased a collection of barns near his farm to serve as his culinary headquarters, he gives himself a two-week deadline to accomplish the task of getting the muck-ridden buildings up and running by Valentine's Day.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth. He also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters, and he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: On May Day, Hugh takes advantage of a healthy crowd that gathers on the Cerne Abbas Giant by selling his famous chocolate waffles. It is also opening night at The River Cottage HQ, and Hugh hopes to serve his guests something spectacular.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: There are new arrivals on Hugh's farm this spring, including 11 piglets and two baby lambs. Hugh also attends an Easter Blossom Picnic Party, goes mushroom hunting for morells, and gets a crash course in breadmaking from a master baker.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh installs beehives at The River Cottage HQ, the only problem is his fear of being stung. He also takes on his biggest event yet, a wedding party, and the newlyweds want their entire menu to only include wild, or home-grown, cuisine.

programme.title: River Cottage: Summer's Here
programme.desc: Hugh wonders if slugs could make it on the River Cottage menu.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: It is party season in Dorset, and Hugh teams up with a local fisherman to catch whelks before spicing them up to sell on the beaches on Carnival Day. Back at The River Cottage HQ, Hugh is inspired to create the West Dorset Tomato Festival.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey, and with some help from Ken Bishop, they carefully extract a robust 25 lbs. worth of the golden sweetness. Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

programme.title: Beyond River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh plans a sumptuous menu for a special Autumn feast he plans to throw at The River Cottage HQ that includes a chicken feast, courtesy of Chickenopolis. It is also a good time of year to go mushroom hunting, but this time, from the air.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage

programme.desc: The pigs have settled in nicely to their new home, and Hugh believes it is now a good time to introduce chickens to the farm. Hugh also finds a pesky garden pest to contend with, learns the finer points of fishing, and visits a fruit farm.

programme.title: Escape to River Cottage

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: Restraining Order
programme.desc: A married woman of 10 years, longs for a life of luxury and opulence. An old flame begins to catch her eye as a means to fulfill that dream, at the cost of her jealous husband. He begins to cause a storm of terror, where she fears for her safety.

programme.title: Tiffany the Doll
programme.desc: She's the perfect partner, she can fulfill your every fantasy, and she's all yours for a price. The newest toy, Tiffany, is no ordinary sex doll, but you have to play to find out.

programme.title: Unintended Consequences
programme.desc: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother’s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fiancée and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

programme.title: The Good Sister
programme.desc: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin’s life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: Bloodline of the Jewel
programme.desc: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala’s world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of someone's dangerous and deadly quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver, Oliver, who vows to help her get answers. Nahdulay is faced with revlations from her past and newly surfaced feelings, as a series of mysterious and deadly events connected to her family unfold.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: New Year New Us 2: #LoveGoals
programme.desc: On a mission to maintain a successful marriage in a city full of temptation, Bakari & Imani are trying their best to get on the same page. But just when things seem to be getting back on track, secrets and lies threaten to tear down everything they've built.

programme.title: Misfortune
programme.desc: When tragedy hits, Rachel is left with more than regret, leaving her bound to a wheelchair and her best friend Sammy's brother Brian with a brain injury. Looking for a new outlook on life, Rachel finds comfort in a new home with more than she bargained for in the form of a fortune teller arcade game, offering her one wish. Will she succeed in bringing her friends back from a detrimental past or will it be misfortune for them all?

programme.title: My Killer Ex Girlfriend
programme.desc: Jocelyn, a possessive romantic, is infatuated with Eric. When he breaks up with her due to her overbearing nature, she refuses to let go. Now, Eric and his new girlfriend, Candice, must escape Jocelyn's vengeful rage. Can they survive?

programme.title: Deceptive Touch
programme.desc: Cam believes she’s finally found “The One” in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant’s past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: The Only Child
programme.desc: Twelve-year old Chris has a wonderful and thriving childhood with her loving family. When her mother dies tragically in a car accident, she begins to go down a dark spiral. When Chris’ father starts seeing another woman, she begins a sinister plan, as no woman will ever replace her mother.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Desperate Desires
programme.desc: Marathon runner Mia is pursued by Jay, while Tori and Paul desire a baby. A one-night stand leaves Mia pregnant, creating conflict with Jay and an opportunity for Tori and Paul. When Mia disappears, her grandmother begs Kirkland to find her, forcing him to confront his past. Whose desires will prevail?

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: The Last Eyewitness
programme.desc: After a violent money exchange in a remote forest leaves several people dead, Riley becomes the only witness to a ruthless crime boss's return. Hunted through the wilderness, she must outlast her pursuers to survive.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: South Side Hero
programme.desc: After serving a 10-year sentence on a RICO charge, reformed gangster Tommy ‘Ace’ Crown returns home to find his 15-year old daughter Sierra missing after she ran away with a man she met online. When the police decline to help, Ace is determined to track her down himself.

programme.title: The Co-Signer
programme.desc: Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.

programme.title: The Green Grass
programme.desc: When money, success, and power becomes your platform it undoubtedly attracts an audience of onlookers; some of who will stop at nothing to get a taste of the good life. But as the plot thickens and the heat intensifies, Shawn's credibility will most certainly be challenged. He'll need to dig deep within himself to stop his life from spinning wildly out of control. This thrilling drama will test his limits as he struggles to find the balance between who he is and who he imagines himself to be. And in the aftermath he'll count up the cost of The Green Grass.

programme.title: Are You Faster Than Blake Leeper?
programme.sub-title: Are You Faster Than Blake Leeper? | Pro Wrestling

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Itchy Witchy Pizza Project / Breakout From Buttvault B
programme.desc: Gretchen, McGee and Squirt get trapped by witch who forces the campers into pizza slave labour. Then, Suzi gives Buttsquat a rare action figure that was sent in a care package meant for McGee.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Scare-A-Normal-Activity / Old Man and the Beast
programme.desc: McGee vows to protect Lakebottom's supernatural secrets from the prying host. Then, the campers befriend Poe, an elderly, former Lakebottom camper.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers summon Armand's old rival, Doofus the Clown, who vows to destroy the campers. Then, McGee prepares the 'best prank ever'.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Who's Ghouling Who? / The Adominable Dr. Squatch
programme.desc: Eager to take the 'Scare and Freak Champ' title from Gretchen, McGee accidentally summons Percy, a ghost with a very 'fiery' personality. Then, the Bottomdwellers film Armand's horror masterpiece.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When McGee, Gretchen and Squirt become lost, deep in the schwamp, McGee and Gretchen argue about the right way back to Lakebottom. Then, Buttsquat challenges the CLB gang to a Capture the Flag game.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers build a race car to help Sawyer relive his pro-racing days. Then, Nanny Num Nums comes to Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Suzi invites her parents for a visit to Camp Lakebottom. Then, the campers train to be Sawyer's Zombie Scouts.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Squirt is eager to assist his idol, Dr. Sapstein, on his latest quest for the rare mocker bird. Then, McGee discovers a paintbrush that unleashes Sawyer's creative genius.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When McGee vows to "out rock" Buttsquat for Best Camp Song , he signs a contract with Sheba the Bandshee. Then, McGee's beloved, lucky rubber duck goes missing!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: When Suzi Attacks / How to Potty Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: When Suzi gets bit by the green eyed jealousy bug, she literally turns green with envy. Then, McGee adopts a fire-breathing dragon named Lizzy who proves to be an unruly pet.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When things start disappearing around Lakebottom, the campers quickly realise McGee's hiccups are the cause. Then, McGee reads a storybook to help Squirt overcome his childhood fear.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers discover an enchanted flashlight and exchange particularly disturbing tales about the Dripper. Then, McStanger inhabits a post-apocalyptic world.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: The Day Squirt Stood Still / Anti Gravity
programme.desc: The campers track down a UFO inhabited by an alien from the planet Squipiter. Then, McGee and Buttsquat argue over who's a better space captain.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: On the eve of Eekmas, McGee blames his toot on Squirt and is visited by three ghosts looking to save Camp Lakebottom. Then, the kids almost ruin the biggest monster holiday of the year!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Looking to save Camp Lakebottom from being overtaken by the Grim Camper, McGee tries to prove how awesome Lakebottom really is. Then, the Bottom Dwellers come across a suitcase in the attic.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: While chasing his gopher-nemesis, Sawyer gets zapped into his brain bin and emerges super smart! Then, McGee takes over the Lakebottom chores when Rosebud heads to the spa.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Ice Queen / Live and Let Squatch
programme.desc: The campers try to reclaim their stolen Lakebottom items. Then, the campers convince Armand to protect his old spy nemesis, Abomina Lafur.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Squirt is captured by a Tooth Troll who claims his baby tooth has enough power to summon all the teeth in the world. Then, Gretchen grows into a Queen Bee.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Suzi and Gretchen get fused into a two-headed Gruzi! Then, Armand and the campers venture into the Petrifying Forest.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The campers must travel back in time to the old west to prevent Grandpappy Black Butt from stealing the deed to Lakebottom. Then, McGee gives Sawyer a high-tech chip that turns him into a Zomborg.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Sweat, Hot Lakebottom Summer / The S'Mogre
programme.desc: McGee becomes a human sweat hydrant after using zombie Sawye'rs anti-sweat cream! Then, McGee gets covered in delicious s'mores toppings, and is transformed into a s'mores monster! A S'Mogre!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Camp Lockdownbottom / All You Need is Larva
programme.desc: Rosebud turns Camp Lakebottom into Camp LOCKDOWN-bottom! Then, Squirt develops a case of worms so bad, they try to EAT all of the Bottomdwellers!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Meet The Gretch's Parents / Now With 100% More Portal
programme.desc: Gretch's famous action-hero, movie-star parents visit Camp Lakebottom, and wind up getting a dramatic motivation they never dreamed of. Then, the kids discover an inter-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Lakebo-tron / Rise of the Dawn of the Beginning of the Planet of Armand!
programme.desc: Buttsquat and McGee get digitised into a classic 80's video game. Then, the Bottomdwellers travel through the interdimensional porta to an all-Sasquatch version of Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: McGee's First Flush / House of Ear Wax
programme.desc: The campers face the wrath of two mutated Ocean Apes, once the pets of McGee and Suzi, now seeking for revenge after being flushed years ago. Then, Squirt's ear wax gains its own consciousness!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Buttsquat uses all the evil tricks at his disposal to brainwash the kids into becoming an elite Butt-Squad of Buttsquat warriors! Then, an alien ship invades Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: I, Rodent / Undies Cover of the Night
programme.desc: Rosebud and the kids are drawn into a Squirrel-version of Lakebottom to answer for their crimes against all Squirrel-kind! Then, McGee's nightmare of being seen in only his undies becomes reality!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Afterlife of the Party / F.L.O.P.P.Y. The Elephant
programme.desc: The kids must halt all partying at once, lest they summon the Party Animal to Lakebottom. Then, the kids befriend a lost circus elephant.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: The Lakebottom House of Horrors! Mwa Ha Ha!
programme.desc: The kids enter a Lakebottom House of Horrors! Only to discover that they will soon be the house's star attractions!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Tur-keepin It Real / Little Saint Nicky
programme.desc: The kids must find their way out of a Lakebottom dimension populated by giant Turkeysaurus Rexes. Then, McGee is desperate to get Santa Claus OUT of Lakebottom, after he crash-lands in camp!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee's toxic-rain induced cold causes his snot to attain future-telling powers! Then, the kids discover that Slimey is secretly hanging out with the Bottomlukers.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: The Old Man and the McGee / Operation: McMOM
programme.desc: Middle-aged McGee travels from the future back to present-day Lakebottom to change the past. Then, the whole Lakebottom gang travels to McGee's town to find out what happened to his parents.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: The kids prepare for the last week of camp by volunteering as staff-in-training to help with the unexpected arrival of two new campers. That is, until Buttsquat takes over the camp!

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Escape from Lakebottom / Rise of the Bottom Dwellers
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt arrive at Camp Lakebottom to find themselves held captive by a zombie, a raging Sasquatch and a ruthless chef. Then, McGee and Buttsquat compete to see whose camp is best.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Late Afternoon of the Living Gitch / Mindsuckers from the Depths
programme.desc: When Squirt's stinky underwear is washed in toxic cleanser, the gitch comes alive! Then, a huge, evil leech attaches itself to Squirt's skull and turns him into Evil Squirt.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: When Sawyer closes the beach because of a giant, raging fish, McGee vows to rid the lake of "Old Toothy". Then, Squirt brings home a baby, monster spider despite Rosebud's ban on pets.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Cluck of the Were-Chicken / Gnome Force
programme.desc: When a hulking were-chicken stalks the camp, McGee must lead the hunt to prove his innocence. Then, Buttsquat gnome-knaps one of Rosebud's garden gnomes.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Cheeks of Dread / Doo Doo Doomsday
programme.desc: Gretchen must confront her greatest fear when the Bottom Dwellers are trapped on Screech Island. Then, McGee's eagerness for presents almost destroys the biggest monster holiday of the year.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Armand goes into a feeding frenzy when wild marshmallows give the campers a rash. Then, McGee and the Bottom Dwellers are hopelessly outnumbered when Suzi moves to Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: Eager to regain his lost prank mojo, McGee releases a mischievous pixy. Then, McGee gets involved in Sawyer's family troubles when he secretly invites Sawyer's estranged mum for a visit.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Terror from the Toybox / Slimeball Run
programme.desc: Buttsquat's Teddy Bear washes up at Camp Lakebottom and hypnotises the Bottom Dwellers. Then, eager to win Buttsquat's awesome new racer, McGee challenges him to cross-Lakebottom race.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Bite of the Buttsquat / Sword of Ittybiticus
programme.desc: No one believes McGee's suspicion that the suddenly ultra-cool Buttsquat is a campyre. Then, during a heat wave, McGee and the gang bring back a glacier.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Headless Horse / Voyage to the Deep
programme.desc: McGee is thrilled when he wins a mounted horse head. Then, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt discover another camp under the lake.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Pirate of Ickygloomy / Attack of the 50-Foot Squirt
programme.desc: While playing Pirates on a shipwreck the Bottom Dwellers must battle the ghost Spitbeard the Pirate. Then, a rare meatball blossom causes Squirt to grow into a giant.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Bloody Marty / Ghost In The Mower
programme.desc: The kids ignore Rosebuds warning and summon Bloody Marty from the ominous mirror world. Then, the Bottom Dwellers summon a ghostly Groundskeeper to help take care of their overgrown soccer field.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Ants in My Camp / Fanboy Freakout
programme.desc: McGee mistakenly concocts a spray that shrinks the campers to a microscopic size. Then, McGee, desperate to win a hovercraft, enters a photo of Armand into a Sasquatch photo contest.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Are You My Mummy? / Slimey Come Home
programme.desc: The Campers and Buttsquat come across an ancient pyramid inhabited by mummy's! Then, something big is lurking in Lake Ickygloomy and causing trouble for Buttssquat...

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: The Superfantastic Mega-Buds / It Came From My Nose
programme.desc: After touching a glowing orb from outer space, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt get super fantastic mega powers! / Then, McGee is sick and confined to his bed.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: High Plains Garbage Eater / Dream a Little Scream
programme.desc: It's Western Week at camp and the gang finds themselves in the middle of a good ol' fashioned show down! Then, the Monsters tuck the Campers in to bed and warn them of the Dream Weevil.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee befriends a frog-like alien creature that crash lands close by Camp Lakebottom. Then, McGee and the gang find an old Tiki Idol that comes to life after McGee plays its bongo drums.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.desc: It's Suzi's birthday and McGee ate her gift! Desperate to find her another gift McGee grows a mutant plant. Then, the Monsters build an arcade game for the Campers based on Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom
programme.sub-title: Clockwork Slime / Ride the Haunted Howler
programme.desc: The Campers find a time travelling clock on the beach and use it to take a trip through Camp Lakebottom's past and future. Then, the Bottom Dwellers come across a haunted cabin ride.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. Leaving the Odyssea at the dock, they hop on a bay boat outfitted with a trolling motor for the ultimate inshore adventure. Gliding quietly through the shallows, they target a variety of species—including hard-pulling Tarpon and explosive topwater Jacks—leaving Rush thinking, “A guy could get used to this kind of fishing!”

With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma — chase big yellowtail around the Coronado Islands or head north in search of bluefin tuna. The options are plenty, the challenges are real, and that’s exactly what keeps fishing in SoCal so exciting.

programme.sub-title: "Hunt for a Kansas giant with Chris Schmidt"

If you hunt big whitetails this is a must see! Follow Adam Hays and Lee Lakosky as they hunt for multiple giants and learn some tactics for harvesting monster whitetails!

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: It might be cold and windy, but if you have trust in your guide the result could be an epic day of fishing! Rush steps up to the challenge and puts Ali on an incredible bite of mutton snapper while also checking another species off of Ali's bucket list!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we show you how we handle selling real estate in the midst of turkey season. When it is time to chase turkeys, our productivity as agents definitely slows a little bit, so that means we have to spend more hours ensuring our clients get what they deserve from us. We bounce around in this one going from taking the kids to school, handling business at the office, showing an amazing property, and finally getting some time to hunt. We hope this episode gives you a bit more insight on just how hectic and fast paced our Springs are at Hunting Land Man in Southwest Mississippi.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Summer Farm Work, Deer Season is Coming!!"
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captain Scott Walker and Nick Haddad of Return 'Em Right fish for snappers out of Hawks Cay while talking about best release practices for bottom fishing.

programme.title: Into The Blue

programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and his former mate Captain Chris Walter take the Invincible cat to fish deep structure for a variety of snappers for Chris to cook for dinner.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.desc: Capt. Jared and Father-Son duo Captain’s Hunter & Chris Barron have Sailfish in their sights.

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The story of Team Winchester shooters Zach Kienbaum and Desirae Edmunds is told. Zach and Desi discuss how they got started in the shooting sports and how important coaching has become to both of them. They also talk shooting tips. Theo Ribbs breaks down the shotgun sports while Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Paul Sawyer, Nikki Boxler and Gabe Adair have a friendly sporting clays competition.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Northwest does not have the easiest conditions to train in for this shooting sports team. For this Seattle-based SST Ravens, this skeet and trap team finds that the challenging weather they train in comes in handy when competing. Also: Competition shooting tips form pro shooter Theo Ribbs.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Capt Brandon visits Quails Landing Plantation in South Georgia and his buddy Steven Redrick to do all things outdoors.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Brandon fishes with Robbie Crosnoe On Lake Henderson. These longtime buddies are dialed into the lake like no one else.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour take ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - The Magdalena Bay Experience, Part Two
programme.desc: One of the best parts of traveling is the pleasant surprises that come along every trip. In last week's episode, Shea McIntee and the crew had a remarkable day of Marlin fishing in Madalena Bay. Now we find out Madalena Bay doesn't only have fantastic offshore fishing, it also has inshore fishing that is out of this world. Shea's captain takes us to some of his favorite spots to catch Red Snapper, Snook, Corbina, and a fish we have never seen before, Palometa.

programme.title: Catching Bass | All About Timing
programme.desc: Being in the Right Place at the Right Time for Huge Bass

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | 2.5-Day Party Boat Fishing Trip on the El Dorado

programme.title: Bill Parker

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Stoked on Coiba National Park, Panama: Part Four
programme.desc: A few years back, we rallied up with my buddy Chris Atkins who owns and operates Central America fishing. He told me, Shea, you have to do a Stoked On Fishing Charters Panama trip and fish at Coiba National Park. It's the largest island in Central America, next to the world-famous Hannibal Bank. Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Finding Walleye
programme.desc: On today's episode of AnglingBuzz TV, we're talking all about finding walleye and how to catch them! Our special guest is Jason Freed who's a fishing guide on Minnesota's famous Leech Lake.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | The Ultimate Baja Mexico Fishing Trip: Stoked on La Paz – Part Three
programme.desc: Welcome to La Paz, the captivating capital of Baja California Sur, situated approximately 3/4 of the way down the breathtaking Baja Peninsula. La Paz is renowned for its stunning seafront beaches, lush parks, vibrant art scene, and waterfront dining that will leave you mesmerized. Join us as we embark on a thrilling adventure diving into this coastal paradise for the very first time.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors
programme.desc: The night bite in Sturgeon Bay is on fire! In this week's episode, we’re meeting with our good friends Lonney Goman from Greenbay Trophy Fishing and Scott Meiller from Rebel Converting to catch some walleye. Hold onto your hineys folks, this will be a long night!

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: L'école des bleus

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Cas de conscience
programme.desc: En plein test d’une nouvelle machine volante, Mitch découvre un radeau avec à son bord une femme naufragée. Mitch doit venir en aide à l’étrangère et retrouver sa sœur. Au QG, Matt et Garner doivent s’occuper d’un couple d’arnaqueurs.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: La sirène au violon

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le cœur a ses raisons
programme.desc: Manny est hanté par son passé alors que deux jeunes délinquants venus de sa ville natale débarquent à Malibu pour du travail d’intérêt général. Neely remarque que Mitch et Samantha se rapprochent.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Guerre des nerfs

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: L'inconnue de la plage
programme.desc: Mitch et Caroline sauvent une femme qui est atteinte d’amnésie à la suite d’une chute. Ils doivent retrouver son père pour l’aider à retrouver la mémoire. Pendant ce temps, CJ rencontre un homme en chaise roulante qui aimerait avoir un accès à la plage.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Coup de poker

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Maigrir ou mourir

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Un futur champion

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Maniobras
programme.desc: Ana decide marcharse, pero María cree tener la solución para que ella y Fernando se den cuenta de que se aman. Catalina se plantea tener sexo con Rafa; éste le aconseja a Bruno, con un interés oculto, que vaya al bar “El Elvis” por su cumpleaños.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Un paso más
programme.desc: Los más pequeños harán todo lo posible por hacer volver a Bruno, que se ha marchado avergonzado. Ana está dolida con Fernando y espera que éste dé un paso más. Carolina se estrena en el teatro con su música. Lucía intenta conseguir que echen al jardinero.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: ¿Y ahora qué?
programme.desc: Ana y Fernando se van a casar por fin; ahora será aún más palpable la diferencia de clases entre la ex show girl y el banquero. Lucía teme que al casarse con Catalina, Rafa se convierta en el padrastro de María. Sharon tiene una gran noticia para Alberto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La esperada boda (Parte 1)
programme.desc: Fernando se ha hecho de nuevo con el control del banco. Ana y él harán todo lo posible para evitar que una serie de desastres y malentendidos impidan que se lleve a cabo su boda, tan deseada por toda la familia, que espera impaciente en la iglesia.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La esperada boda (Parte 2)
programme.desc: Ana, que había subido a un avión con la intención de marcharse lejos, descubre por qué Fernando no asistió al enlace y hace todo lo posible por encontrarle. Tras una boda inolvidable, los novios reciben una noticia que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Ana es una joven que trabaja como bailarina en un local de striptease, el club Chicago. Cansada de intentar, sin exito, triunfar como actriz, acude a una agencia de trabajo temporal para conseguir un nuevo empleo.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Tras su fracasado intento de convertirse en niñera en casa del banquero Fernando Hidalgo, Ana ha regresado al apartamento que compartia con su amiga Sharon, compañera de trabajo en el club Chicago. Se siente triste y echa de menos a los niños.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Carolina, la hija mayor del banquero Fernando Hidalgo, se siente atraida por un chico y se plantea hacer el amor por primera vez. Ana, la nueva niñera de la casa, que tiene una buena relacion con Carolina, aconseja a la joven sobre este importante paso.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Cumpleaños feliz
programme.desc: Va a ser el cumpleaños de Fernando y Ana propone a los hijos del banquero que le ofrezcan una fiesta sorpresa, con regalos y una funcion teatral interpretada por ellos mismos, como solia ser tradicion en la familia antes de la muerte de la madre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.sub-title: Madre no hay más que una
programme.desc: Ana sigue compaginando su trabajo como niñera y sus actuaciones en el club Chicago. Sin embargo se produce una importante novedad en su vida: la asistente social que le ayuda en la búsqueda de su madre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Amores cruzados
programme.desc: Sharon, la compañera de Ana en el club Chicago, tiene un nuevo novio, un hombre adinerado que le va a producir una película. Ana descubre que se trata del padre de Fernando, Don Nicolás, quien aparece en el club.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Fernando sigue obsesionado con Lola, la misteriosa bailarina enmascarada que conocio en su visita al club Chicago. Decidido a conseguir su telefono contacta con Tony quien, en un principio se niega a darselo.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Elemental, querido Bruno
programme.desc: A casa de los Hidalgo llega Alvaro, hijo de un amigo de Fernando a quien los chicos se la tienen jurada por una broma que les gasto. La consecuencia es que el padre de Alvaro queda empapado en pintura.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Tony tiene un inesperado golpe de suerte: gracias a una partida de cartas consigue que un famoso director de teatro haga una prueba a Ana para un importante musical. Ana, siempre atareada y con prisas, tiene que acudir a la prueba con la niña, Lucia.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Banquero al whisky
programme.desc: Carolina, la hija mayor de Fernando, se siente fuertemente atraída por León, un joven que compagina su trabajo como mensajero con ocasionales actuaciones musicales. Carolina aprovecha la fiesta de su hermana Celia para presentar a León a su padre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La familia y una menos
programme.desc: Fernando está muy afectado por la marcha de su hija mayor, Carolina, que se ha trasladado a vivir junto al chico del que está enamorada, León. La casa de este es un estudio pequeño y destartalado que Carolina intenta acondicionar.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La petición de mano
programme.desc: La familia Hidalgo está muy preocupada por el estado del Nando, que ha sufrido un accidente de automóvil. El chico está inconsciente en el hospital y los médicos consideran vital que recobre el conocimiento en las siguientes horas.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Sorpresa
programme.desc: Fernando dedica la tarde a sus hijos. Sabe que los chicos necesitan de su atención y decide llevarlos a un parque temático. Acompañados de Ana, todos disfrutan de una agradable tarde en familia.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Abuela de fin de semana
programme.desc: Bruno recibe un telegrama urgente de su madre. Le informa de que viene de México a visitarlo. El mayordomo suspira agobiado. A fin de que la madre estuviera orgullosa y presumiera de él, mintió en las cartas y fingió una vida que no era la suya.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Decepción
programme.desc: Fernando confiesa a don Nicolás sus intenciones de casarse en breve. Lo que en un principio es una complicidad entre padre e hijo, pronto se convierte en una bola de nieve que crece y crece. Ana es invitada por Fernando a una cena Íntima.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El cometa de los deseos
programme.desc: Ante la huida de Guille y Lucia, la familia avisa a la policia y sale en busca de los pequeños. Fernando, consciente de los motivos de la escapada, pide a Ana que persuada a los chicos para que acepten a Alexia como madre.

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Antes del inicio de las vacaciones de verano, Fernando anuncia a Ana la proxima visita de su hermano David, con el que no ha mantenido contacto durante dieciocho años. El abuelo comunica la noticia a los niños, que reaccionan con sorpresa y expectacion.

programme.desc: Auf einem Minenplaneten treffen sich Elite-Wissenschaftler zu einer Konferenz. Auch Harper ist eingeladen. Da verschwindet Professor Wel-Dar und Harper sucht nach ihm. Unerwartet verlangt ein Vollstrecker, dass Dylan zu einer Unterredung kommen soll.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Crew der Andromeda erhält vom Planeten Misculon die Nachricht, dass sie angegriffen werden. Dylan vermutet, dass Prinzessin Aleiss dahinter steckt. Da erfährt er von König Shineoa San, dass seine Tochter Aleiss von Kullis entführt worden sei.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Eine bewaffnete Flotte des Commonwealth überrascht die Andromeda und nimmt Dylan gefangen. Ihm wird vorgeworfen, dass er die Vereinigung hintergangen habe. Dylans Verhandlung findet in Terazed statt, wo er mehrfach angeklagt wird.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda-Crew untersucht die Ladung eines kleinen Frachters. Dessen Captain Rox Nava hat illegal hundert Menschen an Bord, die er widerwillig nach Androhung von Waffengewalt herausgibt. Er hatte Körperpanzer geladen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Kopfgeldjäger verfolgen die Andromeda, um Dylan und seine Crew an das Commonwealth zu übergeben. Durch einen Unfall wird Dylan jedoch in eine Parallelwelt katapultiert. Seitdem reagiert das Schiff nicht auf seine Befehle.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Wiederholt wird die Andromeda angegriffen, obwohl sie mehrere Slipstream-Sprünge gemacht hat und dadurch stetig ihre Position ändert. Captain Hunt vermutet, dass sich ein Maulwurf an Bord befindet. Er analysiert verschiedene Datenaufnahmen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade und Harper sind mit dem Sternenkreuzer Eureka Maru unterwegs, als sie von Templern angegriffen und gefangen genommen werden. Der Herrscher der Templer zwingt Harper, seinem Volk bei einem Brückenbau zu helfen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Eine Fehlprogrammierung von Harper führt dazu, dass Rommie plötzlich ein Gefühlschaos erleidet. Ausgerechnet in dem Moment, wo sie von Magogs angegriffen werden, verweigert sich Rommie der Befehle der Andromeda-Crew.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Das Team der Andromeda ist in Gefahr: Auf der Suche nach einer geheimen Waffe gegen den gefährlichen Abyss gelangen sie in eine mysteriöse Bibliothek. Was sie nicht wissen: Auch die Geister des Abyss' sind dort, um ihren Krieg vorzubereiten.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda fliegt zu den Arkology, einer friedlich gesinnten Kolonie. Doch dann funkt ihnen ein Weltenschiff der Magog dazwischen, das die Andromeda angreifen will. Die Crew stellt fest, dass sie mit friedlichen Mitteln nichts ausrichten können.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan erwacht wieder auf Seefra-1 nach der "Route der Zeitalter". Hier leben Wesen, die wenig Ahnung von Technologie haben und deshalb ihrem System nicht entfliehen können. Und dann trifft Dylan dort auf seinen früheren Offizier Rhade.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan und Rhade empfangen ein Monat altes Notsignal von Beka, das bislang offenbar noch niemand bemerkt hat. Als sie dem Signal folgen, stoßen sie auf die Andromeda, die funktionsuntüchtig im Weltraum treibt. Doch sie sind nicht die Ersten.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Aus der Lieblingsbar von Dylan, Beka und Rhade wird ein Kunstwerk gestohlen. Angsthormone haben die Besucher außer Gefecht gesetzt. Hinter dem Raub steckt eine gemeine Verbrecherin. Und Harper ist ihr Handlanger! Er reagiert panisch.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Doyle soll kein Mensch sein, sondern ein Androide. Alpträume und Erinnerungen an ein Leben auf der Andromeda bedrängen sie. Ein Fremder, der sich bei einem Raubüberfall vor sie und Harper stellt, kann scheinbar Licht in die Angelegenheit bringen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Beka und Dylan geraten auf Seefra-1 in einen Hinterhalt von Gangstern. Während des Kampfes hat Beka eine ausgesprochen merkwürdige Vision: Virgil Vox, ein Radio-DJ, widmet ihr ein Lied und spricht von einem Geheimnis, welches das Lied umgibt.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan trifft in einer Bar Celine, eine Bekannte aus alten Zeiten, die offenbar in einer Zeitschleife gefangen ist. Der Grund dafür wird bald klar: Gemeinsam mit anderen vedranischen Forschern führte sie in einem geheimen Labor Experimente durch.

programme.title: Andromeda

programme.title: Andromeda
