programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Demo starts on the Charleston projects. Judith talks planting options with Roger, who visits a suitable nursery. Kevin tours the American College of the Building Arts. Richard goes privy diving.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: An old fireplace houses a new stove. Tommy discusses using interior casework with exposed brick. Roger tours hidden gardens. Demolition continues while Tommy and Judith look at flooring options.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: A foundation starts while Roger tries to save a crepe myrtle. Kevin visits Fort Sumter. The single house mantel and windows get restored and the old kitchen house gets connected to the main house.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Kevin meets a lumberjack. Tommy watches how pipes are disguised, and Richard seeks out places for HVAC equipment. Kevin learns about Single Houses. A crepe myrtle gets pruned and Tommy talks termites.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Richard works on plumbing at the Elliotborough house while Kevin meets a kitchen designer. The porch gets assessed. A floor goes down at the single house. Tommy and Mark snake wires through a wall.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The old piazza columns get restored. The iron gate is made by blacksmith students at a local college. Lights are selected for an old house. New siding mixes with old to meet historic district codes.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Charleston boasts a colorful housing stock. Judith decides on a siding color for the Elliotborough project. Kevin meets her and a design expert in a neighborhood famous for house colors, Rainbow Row.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The pergola goes up. Ross looks at smart home technology. A local craftsman puts the finishing touches on a dining table. Richard checks out the HVAC plan while repointing starts on the fireplaces.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The iron gate is fitted at the Charleston Single House. Kevin, Tom, and Richard tour the renovations. Richard visits the Elliotborough project for updates. The completion of the project is celebrated.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: We take a tour of some of the past This Old House project kitchens. Follow the evolution of appliances from white to stainless as well as cabinet finishes from natural to painted.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: From large scale industry to small town makers, these factories provide the materials for our projects.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: From young blacksmiths metalworking to a woodworker who finds centuries-old lumber under water, This Old House features talented makers all over the country who make beautiful household items.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: From demo day to design, we follow every step as the homeowners decide on the components and the crew converts a decades-old butler's pantry kitchen into an up-to-date kitchen for the future.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The guys begin restoration of an 1887 Queen Anne Victorian Cottage. Kevin hears about preserving historic details while updating the interior space and creating a new garage and master suite.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Decorative Queen Anne style barge rafters are reproduced for the garage addition. The antique windows get restored and primed in the shop, re-glazed, and then returned to the house for installation.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Bricks are cleaned and repurposed for a new chimney. Staggered shingles are reapplied. Kevin O'Connor learns about glass orbs hidden on Block Island. Richard Trethewey shows a new shower drain.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: After months of meticulous restoration, the stained glass windows are ready to be reinstalled. Electrician Ben has an apprentice. Tom re-creates original shingles. Landscape meeting with homeowners.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Richard shows how to replace the parts inside a toilet tank. Roger shares tips on above-ground sprinklers and lawn watering. Tom shows how to build a plywood bookcase using portable power tools.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: In the premiere of the 15th season, Tom replaces sash balancers on an antique window. Roger and Kevin check out the benefits of a robotic lawnmower. And Richard talks about treating water with lead.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Kevin visits Chicago to explore the dangers of home fires and ways to stay safe. Scott shows off a portable generator that doesn’t run on gas. The guys ask, “What is it?” And Richard finds a rusted sink strainer in the kitchen.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Tom and Kevin use store-bought stair treads to create a bookshelf in Build It. And landscape designer Jenn Nawada transforms the look of a home’s foundation by using existing plants.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Roger helps plant a home orchard using apple and pear trees. Tom shows Kevin how to choose and use a circular saw. Richard installs a new tank water heater and discusses new regulations on them.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Tom repairs a broken board on a front porch. Richard analyzes a homeowner’s green-stained shower. Scott brings more power to a bedroom and is able to conceal the wiring with crown molding.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Richard learns about a way to heat and cool a house using a new room-by-room ventilation system. The guys ask, “What is it?” And Tom explains the best ways to patch a small hole in the wall.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Ross Trethewey helps build a robotic wall that could be the key to tight spaces in urban living. Tom and Kevin use reclaimed pine heart wood to create a bench with a historic theme in Build It.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Original house details such as the Yankee Gutters and corbels are installed. Kevin O'Connor catches up with the electrician's apprentice. Richard Trethewey looks at the new tankless hot water system.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Mark McCullough explains cobblestone aprons. The crew reinforces floor joists. Tom Silva and Jeff Sweenor install a drop finial and a swinging window. Kevin O'Connor meets with paint experts.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Ceiling mounted speakers disappear in plaster. The new HVAC system gets turned on. New garage doors are side mounted. The pool is lowered into place. The homeowner makes kitchen design choices.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Inside, the team is busy with floor installation, and the design plans for the master bath are finalized. Outside, a custom pizza oven and fireplace arrive, as well the plants and the new pool cover.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Tom assists with interior window trim and custom storm windows. Richard checks out an electric meter and panels. Mark follows work on the hardscape. Kevin watches the assembly of a decorative shed.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Trees and sod are transplanted with Jenn, while a custom deck hatch is installed to access the basement. Inside, Kevin and Jeff assemble a smart lock system and Tom helps mount a unique range hood.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Work happens in the kitchen. Kevin and Tom tackle the molding. The pantry gets a secret door. Countertops, backsplash and tile are installed. A new wood mantle goes around the gas fireplace.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The abandoned Seaside Victorian Cottage is restored to its original beauty. A new addition matches the existing architectural details. New hardscape and landscape anchor it to the corner lot.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Richard travels to Seattle to help a couple choose and install laundry appliances. Tom shows Kevin new table saw technology. And Scott repairs a three-way switch.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Kevin install a home elevator. Jenn Nawada investigates how to grow microgreens. Tom explains the best way to match historic moldings. And Richard diagnoses a problem with well water.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Tom heads to Chicago to transform a one-car garage into a carpentry workshop. Scott installs a wireless light switch. Richard gives a history lesson on antique bath fixtures.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Roger rips up an old, dangerous walkway to replace it with bluestone. Scott explains the best wire nuts to use for each project. Kevin gets a lesson on making mead.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Jenn shares an environmentally safe way to keep walkways safe. Tom gives a tutorial on hand saws. Richard diagnoses a hot water radiator problem. The guys ask “What is it?” Scott installs LED lights.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Jenn learns about rooftop and small space gardens. Tom explains best practices to remove stains from plaster and dry wall. Scott powers a shed by running electricity underground from the house.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Kevin heads to LA to meet up with Nick Offerman. Ross Trethewey looks at a new device to track home energy usage. And Richard shows what happens when you use the wrong soap in the dishwasher.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Tom creates wainscoting out of base cap molding. NASA astronaut Mike Foreman visits to show off a few space tools. Richard helps a homeowner to get enough hot water for his children’s bath time.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Tom and Kevin use scrap to create an end-grain cutting board. Scott installs surface-mounted downlights. The guys ask, “What is it?” And Roger discusses the best ways to keep mice out of your house.

programme.title: Ask This Old House
programme.desc: Scott helps a homeowner raise and lower a light with a motorized lift. Tom shows Kevin the best uses for the jigsaw and how to choose blades. Roger visits Kentucky to help a homeowner repair his lawn.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The show returns to Dorchester, MA, the home of the first This Old House project, to follow the renovation of a triple decker that burned from illegal fireworks.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Asbestos is removed from exposed ductwork. Richard meets the new plumber. Jenn visits a community garden. A local historian speaks about triple deckers. Tom and Charlie pull off the melted siding.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The back porches are brought to code. Ice blasting is used to get rid of the fire odor. New vinyl siding gets installed. Homeowner Carol considers new accent colors to match. Framing begins inside.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Jenn creates a patio building team. Heath rewires a section with intact plaster. Charlie and Tom hang a fire rated door. Richard explains how a tub fits in. Kevin and Tom install a replacement window.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Tom works with new apprentices. Kevin meets them and learns about YouthBuild. Homeowner Carol looks at kitchen cabinets and counters. Richard works with James on separate HVAC systems.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Mauro works with the apprentices to fix plaster damage. Richard meets plumber Ronnette about the new sprinkler system. Carol and her sister shop for tile. The glass doors get repaired by an expert.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Tom and Kevin reinstall cabinets that survived the fire. Tom teaches apprentices to trim a window. HVAC contractor James shows Richard the plan for hot water. Carol and her sister shop for appliances.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: The apprentices attend a roofing class and then put their skills to practice. Back at the triple decker, a vinyl floor goes in. Mauro touches up the cabinets. Tom and Charlie install French doors.

programme.title: This Old House
programme.desc: Well over a year and a half since the fire, the triple decker is just about ready for the homeowners to return. Kevin O'Connor checks out what's left to do in all three units, both inside and out.

programme.title: Three's Company

programme.title: Three's Company

programme.title: Three's Company

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack becomes a hit with TV viewers when he botches a cooking demonstration promoting Angelino's restaurant.

programme.title: Three's Company

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Special guest host Lucille Ball recalls how the trio first met, the wild predicaments of Jack Tripper, how the trio live together platonically, and how they survive each other. Guest Star(s): Lucille Ball

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: "The Best of Three's Company: Part 2." Guest Star(s): Lucille Ball

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack and Furley get locked in a freezer together. Convinced they are going to die, they have a heart-to-heart talk, and Jack confesses that he really isn't gay. Once safe, Jack worries because Furley knows the truth about him.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack thinks Vicky wants a job in Houston and encourages her, causing her to think he wants to end their relationship. She interrupts Janet's wedding to find out why. They make up and the ceremony resumes. Jack proposes and is stunned by Vicky's refusal.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Vicky explains that she is afraid of marriage and suggests to Jack that they live together. Jack reluctantly agrees. They are toasting their first night together in their new apartment when they are interrupted by Mr. Bradford.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack, realizing he can't meet his obligations to pay his share of the rent, gets a part-time modeling job only to find out that he's expected to pose nude. Guest Star(s): Sally Kirkland

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.sub-title: Breaking Up is Hard to Do
programme.desc: Furley discovers that the nice young man that Janet and Jack have fixed Terri up with is a convicted murderer.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet and Chrissy angrily blame Jack for sending them on a wild goose chase to a nonexistent party, never dreaming that it is the Roper's teenage house guest who wants them out of the way so she can have all to herself.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: After a happily-married computer-matched couple sells Jack on the merits of computer dating, the fun begins when Jack secretly signs up.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet buys a blonde wig and is so taken with her new image that she alienates her roommates, Furley, and a new neighbor as well.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack believes Janet and Chrissy are going to oust him from the apartment when their former roommate suddenly shows up.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack, Janet, and Chrissy face having to split up when Chrissy's father, Reverend Snow, announces that their special living arrangement jeopardizes his appointment as the new local minister.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack and Chrissy offer to baby-sit for Stanley Roper's parakeet in exchange for a couple of concert tickets.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack and Janet are shocked as evidence mounts that Chrissy seems compelled to steal, not only from them but also from the Ropers.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: The girls fake a contest to give Jack the rent money he needs for Jack's Bistro. Their good deed turns to disaster when Jack spends the money on a leather coat.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: When an absent-minded policeman leaves his handcuffs at the trio's apartment, Chrissy and Jack playfully slap the cuffs on each other and then discover there's no key. Guest Star(s): Heather Lowe

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy gets a new job selling cosmetics door-to-door, and unexpectedly finds herself in Ralph Furley's winner-take-all strip poker game.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: After a night on the town with his old navy buddies, Jack discovers he has a tattoo on his derriere. When Jack goes to the hospital to have it removed, Janet thinks he is having a vasectomy and Furley thinks he is having a sex change.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack challenges a famous food critic to sample his cuisine, aiming for a favorable review in his newspaper column.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack adopts a new image and changes his career plans to please an affluent woman who'd like to marry him.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A surprise visit by the battling Ropers turns into a romantic triangle when lusty Helen seeks solace from Jack and Janet and lands in the arms of Ralph Furley. Guest Star(s): Norman Fell and Audra Lindley

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.sub-title: Two Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
programme.desc: Jack and Janet mistake Terri's psychiatric friend for an escapee from a hospital psychiatric ward.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack finds himself in a state of panic when he juggles three gourmet dinners in three different apartments.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Terri thinks an attractive older woman's visit to Jack are weekly lessons in lovemaking and, in disgust, decides to move out.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Landlord Stanley Roper plays such a dirty trick on Jack, Janet, and Chrissy that his wife walks out on him.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet is thrilled with her new job as an aerobics teacher, and her new boss Tina is thrilled with Jack. When Tina blackmails Jack into being at her beck and call, Larry offers to take her off Jack's hands.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Instead of catching sleep in the dingy apartment above his restaurant, Jack catches Mr. Angelino with a young woman.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy's good fortune at the racetrack leaves the three roommates with money to burn but tempers sizzle over the distribution of the wealth.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy accidentally eats the pie that Jack was entering in a statewide baking competition and then tries to substitute a ringer from the bakery.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Roper's on a rampage for the rent so Jack's visiting uncle, a charming rascal, passes him a bad check.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack lies to his girlfriend in order to keep a date with his new romantic interest.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Greed tarnishes Mr. Roper's integrity when he is led to believe his old car is a valuable classic after he has sold it for $200 to Jack, Janet, and Chrissy.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack angrily leaves and becomes a live-in cook for Larry's boss and his passionate wife. Guest Star(s): John Larroquette

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy falls for an older man she meets at the supermarket. Jack is jealous, but he's even more upset when Mr. Roper tells Jack and Janet that she knows the man's wife. Guest Star(s): Dick Sargeant

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: When Janet develops a sudden interest in having a baby, Jack and Chrissy hold some hilarious interviews with the men who they think have answered her advertisement for a father-for-hire.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack, Janet, and Chrissy plot to escape a boring Christmas party alone with the Ropers because the three roommates are invited to a big bash the same night.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy and Janet have to solve a gourmet mystery to help Jack graduate from cooking school.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack, Janet, and Chrissy's landlord, Stanley Roper, sells the apartment building but resists his wife Helen's desire to move into a new townhouse in a "swinging" development next door to a snobbish realtor who thinks they will lower the community's tone.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy finds out that Jack has become a male escort and is running around with an older woman.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack has two dates, so he talks Larry into posing as him and spending the day with his unwanted date, Janet's childhood friend, who is visiting from out of town.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack has to do a lot of double-talking on his first night as a busboy at a posh French restaurant when the gang comes to dinner expecting him to be the head chef. Guest Star(s): Michael Lombard

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: When Terri breaks up with her ill-tempered boyfriend, he believes that Jack is the cause. Guest Star(s): Jeffrey Tambor

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A customer of the flower shop names Janet in his will, and she receives a vase. His nephew, Philip, an art collector, visits Janet, and Jack thinks he lied about the value of the vase and is trying to get it back.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack poses as his own twin to romance Ralph Furley's attractive visiting niece.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Larry's sly suggestion that he and Jack trade apartments after Jack has a tiff with the girls gives lustful Larry the chance to really put the move on Janet and Cindy.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack's father visits unexpectedly and resumes his good nature meddling. Jack explodes and tells him to stay out of his life, but when he learns his father has lost his job, Jack gives him the opportunity to be useful.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: El motorista misterioso se revela como una criatura, lo que obliga a Kuuga a luchar.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Parece que los poderes dorados de Kuuga fueron creados por la piedra sagrada Amadam en el cuerpo de Yusuke, en respuesta a su impulso de querer volverse más fuerte.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Kuuga colapsa ante CNI 39 (Go Gamego Re) y Yusuke termina siendo llevado al Dr. Tsubaki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Yusuke derrota a CNI 39 (Go Gamego Re) con el poder dorado en su forma roja nativa.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: CNI 41 (Go Bada Ba) inició sus juegos. Ichijo siente que no podrá contener los ataques de CNI 41 por el TryChaser 2000, que está dañado, y pide que le den la nueva versión, el BeatChaser 2000, desarrollado por Enokida.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: TryChaser finalmente queda inutilizado por los ataques de CNI 41 (Go Bada Ba), deshaciendo la unión que tenía con Gouram.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Una serie de muertes misteriosas de estudiantes varones en la Academia Midorikawa estaba en curso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: CNI 42 (Go Jaraji Da) sigue matando a más estudiantes varones en la Academia Midorikawa, y poco después de que una de sus víctimas rompe el ritmo de su juego al suicidarse, sale en busca de nuevas presas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Sakurako, ya en Nagano, llega al lugar de la matanza para examinar el dialecto de las Criaturas No Identificadas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Mientras Sakurako investigaba las escrituras antiguas recreadas en la Universidad de Shinano, Yusuke, junto con Ichijo y sus colegas, estaban ocupados en Tokio lidiando con las apariciones de CNI 3 (Zu Goma Gu) y CNI 43 (Go Zazaru Ba).

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Ichijo es herido por la mujer con los tatuajes de rosas y es remitido inmediatamente a Kanto HU. Yusuke está decidido a hacer todo lo posible por Ichijo y está desconcertado por las reglas del juego creadas por CNI 43 (Go Zazaru Ba).

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: CNI 43 (Go Zazaru Ba) continúa su matanza mientras CNI 3 (Zu Goma Gu) corre rampante en Chiba. Yusuke corre hacia donde está Go Zazaru Ba y, con el apoyo de Sakurai, lo derrota.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Hay informes de que CNI 0 (N Daguva Zeba) continúa exterminando a otros CNI, y Yusuke, junto con Ichijo y los demás policías, reciben los informes realizados por la Universidad de Jonan.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Kuuga se acerca al CNI 44 (Go Jaza Gi) pero es atacado por ella, sumergido en el agua, arrojándole una lanza que le atraviesa el hombro.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Apareció el CNI 45 (Go Baberu Da), cometiendo asesinatos en una escala nunca antes vista en la ciudad.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Después de derrotar a CNI 45 (Go Baberu Da) y tener algo de paz, Ichijo decide ir al lugar donde Mika Natsume realizará su interpretación de flauta.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: La Fuerza de Tarea Conjunta, cada vez más preocupada por las Criaturas capaces de evolucionar, le pide a Hikari Enokida del Laboratorio de Ciencias Policiales que lleve a cabo contramedidas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Finalmente, CNI 46 (Go Gadoru Ba) comienza su "Gegeru". Con su nuevo poder, lleva a Kuuga al borde de la muerte.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Yusuke estaba tratando de fortalecer su poder dorado para luchar contra CNI 0 (N Daguva Zeba), pero fue derrotado por Go Gadoru Ba, quien imitó el poder dorado de Kuuga.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Gracias a los esfuerzos de la policía y los Kuuga, Go Gadoru Ba fue derrotado, solo que CNI 0 (N Daguva Zeba) sigue al acecho, quien puede llevar al mundo a la oscuridad definitiva.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Yusuke estaba decidido a ser el "guerrero temible", registrado en las antiguas escrituras de Grongi, para derrotar a CNI 0 (N Daguva Zeba) de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Han pasado tres meses desde que Yusuke se convirtió, según las escrituras de Grongi, en el "Guerrero Temeroso" negro con sus cuatro cuernos...

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Los monstruos del "Mundo Espejo" están haciendo que la gente desaparezca repentinamente sin dejar rastro.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Contra ataque de la Araña Gigante
programme.desc: Shinji logró escapar del Mirro-World, pero desde ese día ha sido perseguido por un monstruo dragón. Se despierta en la casa Kanzaki, y Yui le devuelve el mazo que encontró en el apartamento donde vio a ese monstruo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: En uno de sus vagabundeos, Shinji se cruza con un hombre misterioso, que pronto descubre que es el hermano de Yui, Shiro Kanzaki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Aparentemente, Dark Wing, un monstruo que hizo un pacto con Ren (Kamen Rider Knight), atacó a un niño, pero ¿fue eso realmente?

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Hombre Misterioso de la Tienda de Antigüedades
programme.desc: Aparece un tercer Rider: Kamen Rider Scissors. Ren sospecha que Tomoyuki Kaga, dueño de una tienda de antigüedades, es la verdadera identidad de Scissors y busca su paradero.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La pista de regreso a Tijeras que estaba siguiendo Ren no funcionó. Yui recibe la visita de un policía, pero...

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Surgimiento de un Nuevo Tipo
programme.desc: La tía de Yui, Sanako, quien también es propietaria de Atori, ha regresado de un largo viaje al extranjero. A Sanako, al conocer a Ren, no le gusta y lo interrumpe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Sanako, la tía de Yui a la que le gusta mucho Shinji, intenta convencer a los tres (Ren, Yui y Shinji) de que vivan juntos, pero Ren no acepta el acercamiento de Shinji a Yui.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Shimada Nanako, el genio informático del ORE Journal, ha sido secuestrado. Shinji recibe instrucciones de encargarse de este incidente y persigue al secuestrador en una casa abandonada en las montañas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren se lesiona en la pelea contra Zolda (Shuichi Kitaoka). Más tarde, Shuichi intenta usar su posición como abogado para mantener a Shinji en la cárcel, pero Ren y sus colegas lo detienen, evitando que detenga su trampa.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: El "Final Vent" del Kamen Rider Zolda posee un poder altamente destructivo... Ren es arrojado de vuelta al mundo real con gran intensidad, golpeando su cabeza y perdiendo repentinamente la memoria.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Mientras Ren se dirige hacia la Universidad Seimeiin en su motocicleta, pequeños fragmentos de recuerdos del pasado vuelven a su mente.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Ren, con sus recuerdos restaurados y su voluntad de luchar renovada, se enfrenta a un hombre misterioso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Zolda sufrió un contraataque de Ryuki y fue derrotado. Shinji, quien derrotó a un Rider por primera vez, tiene esto fijo en su mente y tiene la intención de dejar de ser un Rider.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: La Leyenda de las Máscaras de Hierro
programme.desc: Miyuki tiene una visión: una batalla entre el nuevo Kamen Rider y Knight, pero Ren no quiere escuchar las palabras de Miyuki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight y Raia siguen a Ryuki al Mundo Espejo y se dan cuenta de que Kamen Rider Gai (Jun Shibaura) le ha robado la tarjeta de contrato de Ryuki.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight toma ventaja sobre Gai y lo acorrala, pero no puede derrotarlo. En el estado en el que se encuentra Ren, Tezuka asume que ha renunciado a ser un Rider y considera que ese punto será su perdición.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.sub-title: El Rider que Escapó de la Prisión
programme.desc: El abogado de Takeshi Asakura, Shuichi Kitaoka, decidió abandonar el caso de Takeshi debido a su comportamiento atroz. Poco después, Shiro Kanzaki aparece en la celda de Takeshi.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Takeshi Asakura está en un restaurante con varias personas y toma a una de ellas como rehén.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Kamen Rider Gai (Jun Shibaura) es derrotado por Kamen Rider Ouja (Takeshi Asakura), y poco después comienza una batalla entre Ryuki y Ouja, aunque el que empezó todo antes fue Ren (Knight).

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Knight se ha aliado momentáneamente con Ouja y lucha contra Ryuki. Junto a Takeshi, Ren una vez más arriesga todo en esta pelea.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Tezuka se encuentra con Shiro Kanzaki en la antigua residencia de Kanzaki. Shiro presiona a Tezuka con una pregunta a Tezuka, por qué no pelea. Poco después, Shiro le da una carta peculiar con las palabras "Survive", lo que implica que sobrevive.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: Goro fue secuestrado por Takeshi Asakura, mientras Zolda se dirige a la batalla contra Knight, tratando de ocultar cierta perturbación en sus convicciones.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki
programme.desc: La esperanza de Shinji de que incluso Takeshi Asakura pueda cambiar se va por el desagüe.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.desc: El parque de atracciones está en pleno apogeo. Los niños corren de un puesto a otro con malvaviscos y manzanas de caramelo en la mano. De repente, una madre angustiada grita "¡Deténganla, deténganla! ¡Me está robando a mi hija!"

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 906
programme.desc: Mientras Nadia ve accidentalmente a Sara del brazo de un desconocido, este mismo hombre es encontrado muerto a la mañana siguiente, solo en su habitación, con el móvil de Sara a sus pies... Y Sara no aparece por ningún lado... ¿Un crimen pasional?

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 907
programme.desc: El SR investiga el descubrimiento por parte de Bernier y Lucas, durante una excursión de pesca, del cadáver de un joven buceador. Los investigadores descubren que esta joven, enfermera de profesión, buscaba un tesoro.

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 908
programme.desc: El SR investiga la sospechosa muerte de un celador que aparentemente es responsable de la desaparición de Leslie. Pronto queda claro que la joven protegida de Bernier presenció cómo el hombre abusaba de una paciente anciana para extorsionarla.

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 909
programme.desc: Tras celebrar una boda, Pauline Domergue, la alcaldesa del pueblo, es encontrada, vestida de noche y con tacones, en lo más profundo del parque del Mercantour... ¡comida por los lobos!

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 910
programme.desc: Soldados con cascos azules y protectores faciales se cuelan en un bosque... Suenan disparos pero ninguna bala impacta. Es un juego de airsoft, dos equipos de jugadores se enfrentan. Georges Martel, líder de los pacificadores, consigue dar en el blanco.

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 911
programme.desc: Noche de las estrellas en el Observatorio de Niza. ¿Qué puede ser más romántico que una visita nocturna a un observatorio? ¿Tener el cielo y las estrellas para ti?

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 912
programme.desc: Una llamada al SR: el cuerpo de Nadia ha sido encontrado en su casa, con un disparo a corta distancia, está desfigurado. El equipo acude a la escena, conmocionado. Cuando comienzan las primeras investigaciones, llega Léo.

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 1001
programme.desc: Es el día de la boda de Bernier. Se casa con su verdadero amor, la novelista Laura Belmont. Mientras la fiesta está en pleno apogeo, el padrino de Laura, un amigo de la infancia, es descubierto asesinado.

programme.title: Unidad de investigación: Episodio 1002
programme.desc: Kevin, un niño de seis años, desapareció con su padrastro, Stéphane. El cuerpo de Stéphane aparece bajo las gradas del estadio de fútbol, muerto a golpes, pero no hay rastro de Kevin.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Faiseur de veuves

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les requins de la drogue
programme.desc: Gage et Sydney s’infiltrent pour retrouver la sœur de Gage, prise en otage par un célèbre criminel.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker connaît la chanson
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent sauver les sœurs Lynn d'un groupe de voyous déterminés à gagner des millions en piratant la dernière performance de leur carrière de chanteuses.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Opération antidrogue
programme.desc: Lorsque Walker ne parvient pas à empêcher le suicide d’un jeune garçon dans son école, il doit surmonter sa tristesse et sa colère et jouer et faire en sorte que l’école s’améliore.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mémoire retrouvée
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers mettent au jour le complot d’une attaque mortelle au gaz sarin sur le pays.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Témoin silencieux
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent protéger une fille sourde qui a été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les gladiateurs
programme.desc: Walker s’infiltre en tant que détenu dans une prison à sécurité maximale en Arkansas pour enquêter sur des matons qui organisent et filment de violents combats entre prisonniers pour les vendre sur Internet au prix fort.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Aigle blanc
programme.desc: Walker fait face à des ennemis redoutables, à la fois internes et externes, lorsque l’explosion d’une bombe détériore sa vision.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le miracle de Noël
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode spécial Noël, Walker et son équipe doivent trouver les coupables responsables d’un vol de cadeaux pour les enfants dans le besoin d'une église locale et d’avoir mis le pasteur dans le coma.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Ranger un jour, Ranger toujours
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent retrouver une bande de voleurs de bijoux qui ont grièvement blessé la fille d'un ex-Ranger lors d'un violent braquage.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dans la ligne de mire
programme.desc: Walker et les Rangers doivent récupérer un nouveau laser sonique sophistiqué et mortel tombé entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Trivette doit aider une étudiante à prouver l’innocence de son père qui a été mis derrière les barreaux après avoir été accusé de meurtre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Grand Nettoyage
programme.desc: Sammo Law (guest-star Sammo Hung, Le Flic de Shanghaï) vient en aide à Walker et les Rangers pour empêcher des suprémacistes blancs de faire des ravages.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Marque du dragon noir
programme.desc: Walker et son équipe doivent empêcher la distribution d'une cargaison massive d'héroïne mortelle dans la ville de Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Couleur de l'intolérance
programme.desc: Pas une minute à perdre pour Walker et son équipe qui doivent empêcher un groupe de suprémacistes blancs de faire exploser des bombes lors d'un rassemblement à Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Retour du général
programme.desc: Walker et son équipe doivent arrêter un violent gang vietnamien responsable de la mort d’un policier infiltré qui enquêtait sur leurs activités illégales.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Casa Diablo (Partie 1)
programme.desc: Une bataille s’engage entre Walker et deux frères violents à la tête d’un cartel de la drogue.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Casa Diablo (Partie 2)
programme.desc: Le combat se poursuit entre Walker et les frères Ortega, des trafiquants de drogue qui ont kidnappé Alex et Sydney.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Danger au lac Ebby
programme.desc: Le week-end de camping de Walker, pour son enterrement de vie de garçon en compagnie de Trivette et Gage, est perturbé par un grizzly affamé et un violent criminel qui compte empêcher les Rangers de témoigner à son procès.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker se marie (Partie 1)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex se marient enfin lors d'une émouvante cérémonie, mais doivent d'abord survivre à de dangereux tueurs à gages qui menacent leur mariage et leur vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Walker se marie (Partie 2)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex se marient enfin lors d'une émouvante cérémonie, mais doivent d'abord survivre à de dangereux tueurs à gages qui menacent leur mariage et leur vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Enlèvement suspect
programme.desc: Des nouveau-nés sont enlevés à l'hôpital du coin quelques minutes après leur naissance.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Ranger de père en fils
programme.desc: Un officier de la police locale retient Alex en otage. Walker doit découvrir la vérité et désamorcer la situation.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La Légende du Bison Blanc
programme.desc: Une statue verse ce qui semble être de vraies larmes et Walker doit découvrir pourquoi.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les Rois du catch
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un ami lutteur professionnel de Trivette est tué dans un mystérieux accident, Walker et Trivette doivent retrouver les coupables et démanteler le syndicat du crime qui se cache derrière ce meurtre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Walker pénètre en territoire inconnu lorsqu’un sénateur lui demande d’attraper un pirate informatique.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le Nettoyeur
programme.desc: De nouveaux agents fédéraux infiltrés sont assassinés et Walker doit démasquer le criminel que l’on surnomme « le Président » qui se cache derrière ces meurtres.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pirate contre pirate
programme.desc: Les Texas Rangers ont du pain sur la planche lorsqu'ils s'en prennent aux associés du « Président », le cerveau derrière les assassinats des agents fédéraux infiltrés.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Un adversaire à sa hauteur
programme.desc: Lorsqu’Alex est kidnappée, Walker se retrouve enfin face au « Président », le cerveau derrière l’assassinat d'un certain nombre d'agents fédéraux infiltrés.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Du Plessis is in a foul mood. It's his 60th birthday and he has no intentions of celebrating it. But the Trevanions have other ideas and Caroline is organising a surprise party.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: All is quiet at Leopard's Den as Sarah, Evan and Olivia gather at the hospital. Danny has been given the all clear to go home. But Du Plessis is still unconscious and seriously ill. Caroline keeps a tender vigil at his bedside.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New lodges nearly break the family, but they learn that it's the animals which make Leopard's Den a success.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny needs an assistant but fails to see that she's right under his nose; Sarah finds out that she needs her mum.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den expands and DuPlessis becomes a grandfather after a close-call with an angry elephant.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Sarah let their past catch up with them, and Caroline and DuPlessis go shopping for lion-prey.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: A white lion brings mixed fortunes to the family and Rosie is asked the big question. Amy Kriel is the last person you expect in Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Caroline's sister Judith tries to help and the drought forces Danny to sell some of his animals. Will Rosie and Max get married?

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: Danny and Alice's project to re-habilitate a group of circus elephants has been a huge success but now they have too many elephants on Leopard's Den, so they urgently need to move the circus herd to the National Park.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is helping to build a new school in the township but when Danny hurts his back he begins to have a crisis about his age. Danny and Alice are surprised when Vanessa comes to them for advice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Mara is hosting a beauty pageant and Rowan realises he needs all the publicity he can get. He buys a tiger from a zoo and convinces Alice he plans to rehabilitate it. Alice is enjoying working with her brother and even defends him to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Alice have been preparing a cheetah for release in the wild but for some reason Danny's mind isn't on the job. He's been pre-occupied because he plans to buy a ring and propose to Alice!

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are taking a well deserved holiday but Olivia's upset to learn they're leaving that day. Angry at missing out on a driving lesson, she decides to take the jeep out on her own.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Alice is enjoying her new job at Mara even though her animal census has revealed they have a lone male hyena that needs a pack. Du Plessis isn't happy about Alice working for next door.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Danny's continued estrangement from Alice is really starting to take its toll. Over at Mara, Alice puts on a brave face as she meets Tom Cox, the owner of a rare male black leopard.

programme.desc: Os astecas constroem um poderoso império que domina a América Central, mas destruído pelo efeito dominó; a 7000 milhas (aproximadamente 11.265 km) de distância, na Turquia moderna, o grande centro de comércio de Constantinopla é invadido por um exército islâmico; os europeus correm para encontrar uma nova rota para o Oriente, terra de ricas especiarias, mas em vez disso, Cristóvão Colombo chega à América e descobre ouro; dentro de 30 anos os astecas são conquistados.

programme.title: Construtores de Impérios
programme.desc: Cruzados, otomanos, venezianos, mouros e impérios europeus construíram grandes fortalezas no Mediterrâneo, que testemunharam batalhas épicas e momentos históricos ao longo dos últimos mil anos. O episódio explora essas batalhas, o projeto e a construção dessas estruturas históricas e seu papel na formação do mundo. Visitamos fortes cruzados em Rodes, Malta e no Levante, fortes otomanos na Grécia, fortes venezianos em Creta e fortes mouros na Espanha, Portugal, Marrocos e Argélia.
programme.category: Temporada 3 Episódio 10 - Grandes Fortalezas do Mediterrâneo

programme.title: Aqui Tem História
programme.desc: Thiago conta a origem do nome de um dos viadutos mais famosos da cidade de São Paulo. Junto de Patrícia, eles comentam a importância do café e do chá na época da independência do Brasil.

programme.title: Legados da Antiguidade
programme.desc: Veja como os povos antigos viveram suas revoluções industriais. Conheça a inventividade e as técnicas que possibilitaram a construção da maior catedral do mundo e de um porto artificial com uma inacreditável tecnologia subterrânea.

programme.title: Construindo um Império
programme.desc: Depois da construção do Pártenon, no século V, a Grécia Antiga alcançou seu maior esplendor. Tinha avançado em direção à democracia e alcançado os maiores índices culturais e artísticos do mundo na sua época. Mas a possibilidade de expansão da Grécia até o momento havia sido limitada por guerras civis. Seria necessária a vontade e a visão de um homem, Alexandre Magno, para expandir os limites do império até a Pérsia e Egito.
programme.category: Temporada 1 Episódio 2 - Grécia - A Era de Alexandre

programme.title: Cidades Ocultas
programme.desc: A cidade do Cairo serviu de assentamento para algumas das civilizações mais antigas do mundo. Seus segredos se encontram submersos sob os vastos desertos do Nilo.
programme.category: Temporada 3 Episódio 11 - A Tumba da Múmias Perdidas

programme.title: A Chegada do Apocalipse

programme.title: Guerreiros

programme.desc: The news of a flight attendant's brutal murder prompted the son of a victim who had been killed five years earlier to contact police. Both murders had similar MOs, and analysis of biological evidence proved that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool, and held her head underwater. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A flight attendant's brutal murder prompts the son of another victim to contact the police.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon went missing, it appeared to be foul play. He left instructions regarding what was to happen if he died under violent circumstances, which were carried out after a hiker came across a bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out, and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police were able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An American tourist is murdered in cold blood while at a Mexican resort.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The investigation of the kidnapping of a prominent banker's wife led police on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man has no recollection of events after stabbing his wife and drowning her in the pool.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A fire investigator determines if a kerosene heater is the cause of a fire that killed one person.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police are stumped in hunting a serial killer in 1957 until new technology help solve the crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police collect evidence leading to a driver who fatally injured a cyclist in a hit-and-run accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man becomes the prime suspect when his parents are killed in a house fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Twenty years after the murder of a young mother technology sheds a new light.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Forensic artist must reconstruct a victim's face before she can be identified.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A wife is missing in Key West; investigators wonder if they should be searching for a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A mother's suicide is not convincing when an attempt on her life three years prior is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Investigators reassemble a 5-1/4 computer disk cut to pieces with pinking shears to find murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Pieces of plastic the size of sand hold clues to a bombing.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Further investigation proves that a woman's suffocation after falling asleep was staged.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A killer is careless when a home is destroyed by fire and a young boy is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Highway policeman is shocked when a bloody traffic collision is classified as an accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. They might not have made an arrest had it not been for a DNA picture of the suspect painted by a molecular biologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process, and then he called 911.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A Modesto, California, teenager went missing. There was no sign of a struggle in her home, and police suspected she'd simply run away until her naked, bruised body was discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a man reported missing, they expected to find his body. But it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly and the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A Native American woman was brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, and the crime scene was rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions, and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect became ill and died just before she was to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy revealed she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators had to determine which person who knew her had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An employee of a dry cleaner was raped and murdered in the store. Police turned to forensic science for the answers they needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected. He flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime scene seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks, and ordinary grass and pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A car carrying three men pulls up alongside another on an Alaskan highway and fires shots, leaving a passenger dead. One of the passengers in the killer's car agrees to testify against his friends. The resulting trials don't end the carnage.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A college student was found dead, and the evidence suggested he knew his killer. Three hairs and some microscopic cells helped police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one person, a suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first, they thought the victims had nothing in common, until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. The killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind, tiny but unmistakable clues which pointed to him and him alone.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, and he'd been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, police discover that a wound sustained by the grieving widow may have been self-inflicted. They turn to science to help unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders. The killer had been careful. He used poison that had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside: physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped the shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan, crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends, and co-workers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist was on the loose in Washington, DC.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Chilling tale of debt and deceit when the head chef of a restaurant is found dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist terrorizes Washington, DC, using the same incendiary device each time. Forensic experts must read the ashes to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A 29-year-old woman was killed instantly when a bomb exploded in her home. The device was so powerful that shrapnel was embedded in houses across the street. The bomber had not only knowledge and skill but also a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A killer tried to incinerate and destroy everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently created new forensic evidence which came to light with a technique never before used in a criminal investigation.
